source.query:
SELECT sum(issue_count) AS issue_count
FROM (
  SELECT count() AS issue_count
  FROM events
  WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
    AND (
      (
        event = '$exception'
        AND properties.alert_eligible = true
        AND NOT (
          lower(toString(properties['$exception_list'])) LIKE '%"value":"script error.%'
          OR (
            lower(toString(properties['$exception_list'])) LIKE '%object not found matching id:%'
            AND lower(toString(properties['$exception_list'])) LIKE '%methodname:update%'
          )
          OR lower(toString(properties['$exception_list'])) LIKE '%chunkloaderror%'
          OR lower(toString(properties['$exception_list'])) LIKE '%failed to load chunk%'
          OR (
            lower(toString(properties['$exception_list'])) LIKE '%loading chunk%'
            AND lower(toString(properties['$exception_list'])) LIKE '%failed%'
          )
          OR lower(toString(properties['$exception_list'])) LIKE '%failed to fetch dynamically imported module%'
          OR lower(toString(properties['$exception_list'])) LIKE '%importing a module script failed%'
        )
      )
      OR event IN (
        'stale_chunk_recovery_failed',
        'reminder_scheduler_backlog_detected',
        'reminder_email_delivery_failed',
        'reminder_email_complaint_received'
      )
    )

  UNION ALL

  SELECT count() AS issue_count
  FROM (
    SELECT
      properties.scheduler AS scheduler,
      maxIf(timestamp, event = 'reminder_scheduler_failed') AS last_failure,
      maxIf(
        timestamp,
        event = 'reminder_scheduler_run_completed'
          AND properties.status = 'healthy'
      ) AS last_healthy
    FROM events
    WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
      AND event IN (
        'reminder_scheduler_failed',
        'reminder_scheduler_run_completed'
      )
    GROUP BY scheduler
    HAVING last_failure > last_healthy
  )
)

before.description: Actionable application and email problems in the trailing hour. Generic cross-origin, browser-extension bridge, and stale Next.js chunk failures are excluded; repeated stale-chunk recovery failures still alert. Scheduler failures count only while unresolved by a later healthy run.

Classification owns exception exclusions; message/stack substring filters must not override it. Scheduler failures count until a later healthy run.
